subject: İngilizce Dersi
title: Unit 7: Jobs
description: Describing what people do and expressing what people like: What is your job? —I’m a doctor. I work at a hospital. —I’m a farmer. I like animals and I work on a farm. What does s/he do? What does s/he like? —She’s a teacher, and she likes teaching children. | Making inquiries: Where does s/he work? —at the post office. —at the police station.

outcomes.title: Students will be able to identify other people’s jobs and likes in a short, simple oral text
Students will be able to talk about other people’s jobs and likes in simple conversations
